cases.name: Bookings UTC day and status filters
cases.assertions: Full UTC creation day, previous/next day exclusion, all/confirmed/cancelled statuses, exact CSV/XLSX rows and PDF totals

cases.name: Flight departure day and status
cases.assertions: Same flight IDs, departure day, selected status, seat totals and estimated revenue

cases.name: Revenue and later partial refund
cases.assertions: Real wallet charge, ticket creation and partial refund APIs; ledger posting day, credit funding separation and CSV/XLSX/PDF reconciliation

prior_acceptance.note: Direct tRPC createCaller against real SQL; distinct from browser E2E. PDF tenant isolation validation checks header only.

coverage_limits: This is the repository's selected CI E2E suite, not every test across all configured browsers.
Dedicated browser download tests cover three report families; Refunds download still lacks a dedicated browser case.
Tenant/finance/ops export isolation is demonstrated by prior SQL/tRPC acceptance, not by all browser download paths.
The report linkage test validates PDF headers, not absence of another tenant's PDF content.
No claim of all 99 public Videcom examples, 200 vendor reports, or external airline-provider certification.
publication_note: This receipt describes execution on source_sha. The later documentation commit is not the tested source commit. The ZIP is the unchanged GitHub Actions artifact; JSON sidecars are readable summaries.
